description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on end wall. Seating: no sofa visible; a dining table with chairs sits in the centre near the lower wall. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Unclear bed. Bed partially visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Sleeping alcove offers slight visual separation but cooking smells reach the sleeping area. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (single open studio space, no separate bedrooms); couples needing privacy (open-plan bed area with no partition or door); anyone needing significant storage (no wardrobe, very limited storage); remote workers needing a dedicated office (no desk or separate work zone).
